dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - Executive - Service Overview
dashboard.description: 24 hour overview for backend availability, APM throughput and latency, errors, host health, PostgreSQL health, and log volume. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Service health
pages.description: Default 24 hour production overview with links to deeper backend dashboards as they are added.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 50, 95, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT apdex(duration, t: 0.5) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duration), percentile(duration, 95), count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET transactionName, error.class LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(cpuPercent), average(memoryUsedPercent) FROM SystemSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(diskUsedPercent), average(networkReceiveBytesPerSecond), average(networkTransmitBytesPerSecond) FROM SystemSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(db.connections), latest(db.sizeBytes), latest(replication.lagSeconds) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET database LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND level IN ('warning', 'error', 'critical') FACET level TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS false) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Use the PHP APM, host, Caddy, PHP-FPM, PostgreSQL, logs, synthetics, release health, and regression dashboards for drill-down. Those dashboard definitions are managed in this repository as each issue lands.
